units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:1">Ber. III, 1</cite> the carriers <he>וחִילּוּפֵיהֶן וחִילּוּפֵי וכ׳</he> and those designated to relieve them, and those who are to relieve the relief.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>יש להם ח׳</he> can be replaced; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:5">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> <cite ref="H01058"><he>חֲלִיפִין</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="H01001"><he>חלוף</he></cite>, <cite ref="Proverbs 31:8">Prov. XXXI, 8</cite>) <he>שהן חִלּוּפֵי אביהם</he> for they take the place of their father; a. fr.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 46b:8">Ab. Zar. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>או ח׳</he> is it not rather the reverse?; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:11:2">Y. Taan. III, 67ᵃ</cite> <he>או חֵלֶף</he>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:12:5">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 45ᵇ</cite> top; a. fr.—<he>ח׳ הדברים</he> the things are just the reverse.
Y. Ter. II, 41ᶜ bot.; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:51">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> top <he>אבל בגוים ח׳</he> but as regards gentiles, the opposite takes place.
